'''Haguro Shrine''' (羽黒神社) refers to various [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] across Japan. Many are considered to have been established through the [[Bunrei|Enshrinement]] of [[Dewa Shrine|Dewa Shrine]] in [[Tsuruoka|Tsuruoka City]], [[Yamagata Prefecture|Yamagata Prefecture]], which enshrines [[Haguro Gongen]].

* [[Haguro Shrine (Fukushima City)]] - Located in [[Fukushima (city)|Fukushima City]], [[Fukushima Prefecture|Fukushima Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Motegi Town)]] - Located in [[Motegi, Tochigi|Motegi Town]], [[Haga District, Tochigi|Haga District]], [[Tochigi Prefecture|Tochigi Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Funabashi City)]] - Located in [[Funabashi|Funabashi City]], [[Chiba Prefecture|Chiba Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Nagaoka City, Onuki)]] - Located in Onuki, [[Nagaoka, Niigata|Nagaoka City]], [[Niigata Prefecture|Niigata Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Nyuzen Town)]] - Located in [[Nyūzen|Nyuzen Town]], [[Toyama Prefecture|Toyama Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Suzu City)]] - Located in [[Shōin]], [[Suzu, Ishikawa|Suzu City]], [[Ishikawa Prefecture|Ishikawa Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Kurashiki City)]] - Located in [[Kurashiki|Kurashiki City]], [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]].
* [[Haguro Shrine (Fukuoka City)]] - Located in [[Southern District]], [[Fukuoka|Fukuoka City]], [[Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka Prefecture]].
